newsitem.title: USA: Royal Grip to merge with FM Precision.
newsitem.headline: Royal Grip to merge with FM Precision.

text.p: Royal Grip Inc said Thursday it had signed a definitive agreement to merge with FM Precision Golf, a privately-held golf shaft manufacturer based in Torrington, Conn.
Royal said its security holders will own 30 percent and FM holders 70 percent of the fully diluted shares of the combined company.
Royal, which makes golf club grips and sports headwear, said the new parent company will be called Royal Precision Inc and will trade on the Nasdaq Stock Market.
Royal did not say how much the deal was worth. Officials at the company and at FM Precision were not available for comment.
Royal today reported a first-quarter loss of $0.29 a share, against a loss of $0.21 a year ago.
Royal's stock was up 1/4 at 4-1/4 in early trading.
